description: Featured placements on affiliateprogramterms.com: a company's affiliate program shown at the top of its category page and under its category on the home page, labelled "Featured", 7d: 7 days for $27, 30d: 30 days for $72, 5 per category, never renewing. Returns, per category, how many spots are open and when the next opens. Use when someone wants to promote their affiliate program to people comparing programs, or asks what featuring costs. Listing itself is free and never sold; featuring changes no figure and no order.
name: featured_availability
title: See featured spots by category
